question: The final defeat of Mir Qasim in the hands of British took place at the battle of _______.
solution:
The correct answer is__** Buxar**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Battle of Buxar**:

 
 
• **Mir Qasim **was **defeated by the British i**n the** Batlle of Buxar **on** 22nd October 1764**.
 
• The** reason** behind the battle was due to** Mir Qasim's discontent over the British East India Company's continuous expansion in Bengal and other parts, as well as its misuse of Farmans and Dastaks, legal instruments of the Nawab**.
 
• The British forces were under the command of the** British East India Company** led by** Hector Munro**.
 
• The battle was between the British troops against the combined armies o**f Mir Qasim, Nawab of Bengal **till 1764; **the Nawab of Awadh**, **Shuja-ud-Daula**; and the **Mughal Emperor, Shah Alam II**.
 
• The battle was fought at Buxar, a **"strong fortified town"** located within the territory of** Bihar**.
 
• The war was brought to an end by the** Treaty of Allahabad in 1765**.
 
• After the defeat,** Mir Qasim also fled with his 3 million rupees worth of gemstones and later died in poverty in 1777**.
 
• **Shah Alam II surrendered **himself to the British.
 
• **Shah Shuja fled west hotly pursued by the victors**. He eventually **surrendered by 1765**.
 
• Then the** British** had become the **virtual rulers of Bengal, Bihar and Orissa**.
